item.tib: mtshan nyid dam bca'i dbu 'chad pad dkar chun po
item.coloph: zhes gang gi skar brnyes rgyal kun ngo bo rje/ gang gi thugs brtses 'gro la nyer gzigs nas/ gang gi lung zin sangs rgyas dngos 'byon zhing / gang gis 'gran bral g.yung drung gling chen du/ dam bca' pod chen drug gi khyab 'phring (phreng) 'di/ snyan grags mkhas par 'dod pa ma yin kyang / che ba'i mtshan btags legs pa'i mnga' gsol skabs/ rang 'dra'i blo rmongs dgos gnas che ched du/ yongs 'dzin thu bo blo gros rgyas mtshan gyis/ bshad sgrub bstan la phan phyir bsgrigs pa 'di/ phyogs brgyar kun tu dar zhing rab 'phel nas/ nam yang mi nub srid mthar gnas gyur cig/
